items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: But there were two marvelous musicians, tenor saxophone player named George Neely, out of Oklahoma City, and a trumpet player,

ctx.x: So I'm just dying. I bought all kind of shoes, all colors. When I got back to Los Angeles, and slept about a week, didn't one pair of those shoes fit because my feet had been so swollen up there. [PAUSE]

Back to this job in Sacramento, there was another night club that stayed open a little later than us. It was the Club Eureka. I forget the bandleader's name. But there were two marvelous musicians, tenor saxophone player named George Neely, out of Oklahoma City, and a trumpet player,
migrated from Kansas City, his name was Flowers. Can't recall his first name. But he had a drinking problem.
